ext7e_left.source: p33 vector path (Ext. Data Fig. 7e, left)

extrapolated_y0.systematic_method: half-range over x_max in 0.3-0.6 and 3-5 even terms
extrapolated_y0.method: least squares a0 + a2 x^2 + a4 x^4 + a6 x^6 on the points with x <= 0.40

ext7e_left.notes: The plotted line is clipped at the 30 kV/m axis limit for V_L/V_Lc < 0.1008; the first point is the clip point. E_c(0) is the even-polynomial extrapolation in extrapolated_y0. The kink near 1.21 is the ring onset x* = 1.21347, where the gap minimum leaves k = 0. For V_L/V_Lc <= 1.2 the curve follows the Methods 6 closed form. With M = -1.0215 meV, whose V_Lc is the paper's 0.9134 meV and E_c(0) = 30.396 kV/m, the max |difference| is 0.030 kV/m. With the printed M = -1.022 meV (E_c(0) = 30.450 kV/m) it is 0.075 kV/m. Compare with max(tolerance_rel * y, tolerance_abs). Duplicate x removed: 0.

ext7e_right.source: p33 vector path (Ext. Data Fig. 7e, right)
ext7e_right.notes: The axes are tight around the data: the first vertex is the bottom-left corner of the box at V_L/V_Lc = 1.120, where Lambda = 0.118 kV/m > 0 (the diabatic onset x_d = |M|/V_Lc = 1.118 lies just outside the plot). The y axis is calibrated on the 5 and 15 ticks; the 10 tick is off that line by 0.036 pt, while the '0' tick is misplaced by -0.43 pt (it sits at the box bottom, not at Lambda = 0). The diabatic model (M = -1.0215 meV) matches the vertices to about 0.02 kV/m. Duplicate x removed: 0.

ext7d_left.source: p33 vector paths (Ext. Data Fig. 7d, left; palette magenta N = 3 -> cyan N = 21)
ext7d_left.notes: Ten curves N = 3, 5, ..., 21. The marker circles drawn on every 8th vertex are ignored. The fits of Methods 4.2 are qualitative, so the plan accepts +-10% (M10). Duplicate x removed: 0.

ext7d_right.source: p33 vector paths (Ext. Data Fig. 7d, right; palette magenta N = 3 -> cyan N = 21)
ext7d_right.notes: Ten curves N = 3, 5, ..., 21. The marker circles drawn on every 4th vertex are ignored. The fits of Methods 4.2 are qualitative, so the plan accepts +-10% (M10). Duplicate x removed: 0.

ext7c.source: p33 vector paths (Ext. Data Fig. 7c): gray marker centres and the black fit lines
ext7c.notes: The caption says V_L/V_Lc = 1.8, but the markers equal the Ext. 7d curves at V_L/V_Lc = 1.4 (see comparison_with_ext7d). The markers are stored raw, unchanged. line_x/line_y are the plotted fit lines (Methods 4.2), sampled at the same N. Calibration: least squares over the ticks. The axes span N = 0..21, E_c^N = 3..30 kV/m (left) and f_N = 6..22 kV/m (right).

ext9b.quantity: N J^(N omega) vs E_0/N, theory curves (per the analysis: full Eq. 10 at T1 = T2 = inf, plotted = printed x 1/(4 pi))
ext9b.source: p35 vector paths (Ext. Data Fig. 9b, theory; palette magenta N = 3 -> cyan N = 21)

guide_line.notes: dashed guide labelled 1.5; its slope in data coordinates is 1.42 (not a target)

ext9b.notes: Every curve covers E_0 = 0.00101..2.75e+03 V/m (146 points, 0.046 decades apart), so its E_0/N range shrinks with N. derived.loglog_slopes are least-squares slopes of log10(N J) vs log10(E_0/N) over the points in each window; each window is truncated to the curve's range. Expected from the analysis: log10(N J) = -7.18 at E_0/N = 1 V/m for N >= 9 (-7.09 for N = 3), and slopes 1.43-1.44, 1.40-1.42 and 1.26-1.35. The vertices are snapped to about 0.08 pt, i.e. 0.015 decades in y. Duplicate x removed: 0.

ext7a.source: p33 embedded JPEG images (objects 1013/1012/1011/1007) and colour bar 1008
ext7a.notes: 3x3 median of the colour position t, then the colour-map bin centre c (49|t| + 0.5)/50 with sign(t) (white -> 0); NaN where saturated (|v| >= 0.98 c), sign kept in saturated_N; c is the round colour limit (10, 1, 0.3, 0.15 mA/m); the bar image extents mapped through the tick calibration are ~1% larger, as for the 7b bar labelled +-3 (extent 3.022), so the images overshoot their limits by ~0.3 pt; systematic uncertainty of c about 1%; values are colour-map bin centres (+-0.01 c); JPEG noise (IJG quality 75, 4:2:0) is <= 0.004 c at the 95th percentile and up to 0.06 c at isolated sharp fringe edges

known_inconsistencies: Ext. Data Fig. 9h, trivial side (V_L > V_Lc): the plotted g_xx is off by a factor of about 2.85 relative to the rest of the calculation. Do not use it as a regression target.
Fig. 5b, panel 2 is internally inconsistent with the other panels. Do not use it as a regression target.
Fig. 5a: the colour-bar scale of the quantum metric g is inconsistent with the plotted data. Do not use it as a regression target.
Ext. Data Fig. 9g caption: g_xx^EXP = (eps_g/(e E_c))^2 omits the factor (pi/4)^2 = 0.617 that Eq. 8 implies, g_xx = (pi eps_g/(4 e E_c))^2.
Units 'mA/m^2' on the Ext. Data Fig. 7a/7b colour bars: J_y^(N omega) is a 2D sheet current, so the unit is mA/m. ext7a_maps.npz stores mA/m.
Ext. Data Fig. 9b: the dashed guide line labelled '1.5' has slope 1.417 in data coordinates. The theory curves have local log-log slopes of 1.26-1.44, computed with T1 = T2 = inf.
Ext. Data Figs. 7b/7c captions say V_L/V_Lc = 1.8, but the Ext. 7c values coincide with Ext. 7d at V_L/V_Lc = 1.4: the max |difference| is 0.16 kV/m at 1.4 and 15.56 kV/m at 1.8.
